plugin.name: Partroxis
plugin.author: Eric
plugin.purpose: Click a room in the Partroxis maze list and it walks you there, one exit at a time
plugin.description:
Partroxis - a Partroxis maze walker.
psx pop up the list of rooms with the mob in each psx stop stop walking psxgo carry on after a stop or a fight psx help everything else
Click a room and it walks the maze to it, one step at a time, with a 0.3 second pause in every room so it can never run past the one you picked. A wrong exit is learned and doubled back from. The exits it learned are kept when you leave, so a trip back in walks straight there; the first known exit that turns out wrong means the maze changed, and it relearns. An attack stops the walk; once the fight is over type psxgo and it goes invis / hidden / sneak again and carries on.
Based on Galaban's Partroxis plugin (room and mob data, exit matching).

muclient.script:
require "aardwolf_colors" pcall (require, "themed_miniwindows")
local GMCP_ID = "3e7dedbe37e44942dd46d264" local VERSION = "1.1"
-- Colour scheme (same as MazeMobber) local CLR_TAG = "#875FFF" -- brackets / dim accents local CLR_NAME = "#00D7FF" -- names local CLR_MSG = "#FFFFFF" -- message text local CLR_HI = "#00FF87" -- commands, values, clickables
-- Timing local PAUSE = 0.3 -- pause in every room before the next move local FIGHT_RESUME = 0.3 -- after a fight ends, before carrying on local INVIS_DELAY = 1.5 -- after hide (it lags a second); the other casts go out back to back local MOVE_TIMEOUT = 2.5 -- a move that has produced no new room by now is retried local EXITS_SETTLE = 0.15 -- after the exits header, before reading the lines local HIDE_FALLBACK = 4.0 -- hide sent but no hide / already-hiding message: carry on anyway local AFF_SETTLE = 0.3 -- no new line this long after the affects list: it is complete local AFF_TIMEOUT = 4.0 -- the first affects check: no list by now, so cast everything local MIN_LEFT = 120 -- seconds left on an effect for it to count as up local EXITS_TIMEOUT = 6.0 -- no exits list at all local MAP_LIFE = 900 -- a map older than this (from the first trip in) is a new maze
-- =========================================================== -- Notes: everything is held back 0.2s so a line printed on arrival -- does not land above the room description. -- =========================================================== -- MUSHclient's DoAfterSpecial refuses any delay under 0.1s (eTimeInvalid) and -- says nothing - the timer is simply never made, so a 0.05s "step" never -- fires and the walk stalls without a word. Every timer goes through here: -- the delay is floored at 0.1 and a refusal is announced, never silent. function PSX_After (delay, code) if not delay or delay < 0.1 then delay = 0.1 end local rc = DoAfterSpecial (delay, code, 12) if rc ~= 0 then ColourNote ("#FF5F87", "", "[Partroxis] A timer was refused (code " .. tostring (rc) .. ", " .. tostring (delay) .. "s): " .. tostring (code)) end end
local msg_q, msg_armed = {}, false
local function flush_notes_now () if #msg_q == 0 then return end local q = msg_q msg_q = {} for _, s in ipairs (q) do AnsiNote (stylesToANSI (ColoursToStyles (s))) end end
function PSX_Flush () msg_armed = false flush_notes_now () end
local function cnote (s) msg_q[#msg_q + 1] = s if not msg_armed then msg_armed = true PSX_After (0.2, "PSX_Flush ()") end end
local function note (msg) cnote ("@x099[@x045Partroxis@x099]@w " .. msg) end
local function note_now (msg) cnote ("@x099[@x045Partroxis@x099]@w " .. msg) flush_notes_now () end
local function warn (msg) cnote ("@x099[@x045Partroxis@x099]@w @x203" .. msg .. "@w") end
local debug_on = false local function dnote (msg) if debug_on then cnote ("@x099[@x045psx debug@x099]@w " .. msg) end end
-- =========================================================== -- Maze data (from Galaban's plugin) -- 5763 is the entrance, 5764-5803 the maze, 5812 the Opus past the last gate. -- Every room's right exit leads to the next id; wrong exits are one-way -- trips back somewhere earlier. -- =========================================================== local ROWS = { {5764, "In the Mountains", "A Mountain of Rock"}, {5765, "Through the Woods", "The Rabid Tiger-man"}, {5766, "The Forest", "The man-eating wolfen"}, {5767, "Swampy Path", "The Buck-Toothed Lizard-Man"}, {5768, "The Forest", "The Living Tree"}, {5769, "Along the River", "The Furious Flying Fish Man"}, {5770, "The Desert", "The Quicksand"}, {5771, "The Desert", "The Flesh Eating Ants"}, {5772, "The Wheat Fields", "The Living Vines"}, {5773, "In the Mountains", "The Gigantic Bulette"}, {5774, "In the Mountains", "A Bird of Prey"}, {5775, "A Cave", "The Otherworld Assassin"}, {5776, "The Wheat Fields", "Vision of a False Portal"}, {5777, "The Wheat Fields", "The Hungry Dragon"}, {5778, "The Forest", "A Bloodthirsty Tiger-Man"}, {5779, "The Swamp", "The Cold Hearted Lizard-Man"}, {5780, "The Swamp", "The Insane Cheryb"}, {5781, "River of Blood", "Flowing Blood"}, {5782, "A small Cave", "A collapsing cave"}, {5783, "A small Cave", "The Dream Eater"}, {5784, "Through the Passage of Time", "Reality Check"}, {5785, "The Swamp", "Blood Sucking Vines"}, {5786, "The Forest", "The Golden Haired Assassin"}, {5787, "The Wheat Fields", "Mass of Flying Dismembered Body Parts"}, {5788, "The Wheat Fields", "Bloodthirsty Killer Gerbils"}, {5789, "In the Mountains", "A Monster Bulette"}, {5790, "The Wheat Fields", "the Thing"}, {5791, "Along the River", "The Big and Deadly Dragon"}, {5792, "The Wheat Field", "Soul of the Damned"}, {5793, "In the Mountains", "Lesser Chitryn"}, {5794, "In the Mountains", "Delusions of Hope"}, {5795, "The Desert", "Swarm of Blood Sucking Bio-chemical Gnats"}, {5796, "The Swamp", "It"}, {5797, "The Desert", "Your Worst Nightmare"}, {5798, "The Wheat Field", "Walking Suit of Armor"}, {5799, "A Cave", "Lesser Otherworld Dragon"}, {5800, "A Cave", "Insane Cheryb"}, {5801, "In the Mountains", "Otherworld Dragon"}, {5802, "In the Mountains", "Hell Hound Behemoths"}, {5803, "A vast Expanse of Plains", "Chitryn"}, {5812, "The Opus", "Grax, Lord of the Opus"}, }
local ROOMS, POS = {}, {} for i, r in ipairs (ROWS) do ROOMS[r[1]] = { name = r[2], mob = r[3], n = i } POS[r[1]] = i end -- The way in: each of these is one command (or a short stack) that moves -- you one stage nearer the maze. Arrival is checked by "the room changed", -- not by an id, so a wrong guess about the middle rooms cannot wedge it. local APPROACH = { [5862] = "enter partroxis", [5814] = "enter partroxis", [5813] = "enter other", [5763] = "open n;n", } POS[5862], POS[5814], POS[5813], POS[5763] = -3, -2, -1, 0
local GATE = { [5777] = true, [5792] = true, [5803] = true } -- "enter gate", not a direction local DIRS = { "n", "e", "s", "w", "u", "d" } local DIRKEY = { north = "n", east = "e", south = "s", west = "w", up = "u", down = "d" }
local function next_id (r) if r == 5803 then return 5812 end return r + 1 end
local function roomlabel (id) local r = ROOMS[id] if r then return r.name end return "room " .. tostring (id) end
-- =========================================================== -- State -- =========================================================== local cur = nil -- room we are in local state = 3 -- char.status state: 3 active, 8 fighting, 12 running local walking = false local target = nil -- room id clicked local pending = nil -- { from, dir, approach, retries } a move sent, no new room yet local rooms = {} -- learned: rooms[id] = { dir, next, ok, wrong = { [dir]=true } } local map_start = nil -- os.time () of the first trip in on this map local need_invis = false local fight_stop = false -- a fight stopped the walk: psxgo carries on, and casts first local step_gen = 0 local wd_gen = 0 local ex_gen = 0 local exits_buf = {} local exits_for = nil local exits_ready = false local exits_dark = false local exits_wait = false -- a capture is in flight local invis_cmds = GetVariable ("invis") or "c invis;sneak;hide" if invis_cmds == "c invis;hide;sneak" then invis_cmds = "c invis;sneak;hide" end -- the old default: hide goes last now local auto_list = (GetVariable ("auto") ~= "n") local fast_known = (GetVariable ("fast") ~= "n") -- walk a known stretch as one run, no pauses local invis_delay = tonumber (GetVariable ("invisdelay") or "") or INVIS_DELAY if invis_delay == 1.2 then invis_delay = INVIS_DELAY end -- the old default; it is 1.5 now local invis_why = "" -- what the cast note says local check_buffs = (GetVariable ("check") ~= "n") -- read the affects first, cast only what is missing local aff_cmd = GetVariable ("affcmd") or "saff" local buff = nil -- the cast routine in flight local buff_gen = 0 local aff_gen, aff_set = 0, 0 -- the affects read in flight local aff_wait = false local aff_buf = nil local aff_cb = nil local buff_cancel -- defined with the cast routine, used by cancel_all local precast = (GetVariable ("precast") ~= "n") -- cast them before every new walk local win_font = GetVariable ("winfont") or "Consolas" local win_font_size = tonumber (GetVariable ("winfontsize") or "") or 12
local function in_area (id) return id ~= nil and POS[id] ~= nil end
-- =========================================================== -- The walk -- =========================================================== local function schedule (delay) step_gen = step_gen + 1 PSX_After (delay or PAUSE, "PSX_Step (" .. step_gen .. ")") end
local function cancel_all () step_gen = step_gen + 1 wd_gen = wd_gen + 1 ex_gen = ex_gen + 1 exits_wait = false pending = nil buff_cancel () EnableTriggerGroup ("psx_exit", false) end
local function abort (msg) walking = false cancel_all () warn (msg .. " Type @x048psxgo@w to carry on.") end
local function stop_walk () walking = false cancel_all () end
local function arrive () walking = false cancel_all () local r = ROOMS[target] note ("Arrived: @x048" .. (r and r.name or tostring (target)) .. "@w - @x045" .. (r and r.mob or "?") .. "@w is here.") end
local function arm_watch () wd_gen = wd_gen + 1 PSX_After (MOVE_TIMEOUT, "PSX_Watch (" .. wd_gen .. ")") end
local function send_move (dir, approach) pending = { from = cur, dir = dir, approach = approach, retries = 0 } exits_ready = false dnote ("move " .. dir .. " from " .. tostring (cur)) Execute (dir) arm_watch () end
-- A move that has not produced a new room. function PSX_Watch (g) if g ~= wd_gen or not walking or not pending then return end if cur ~= pending.from then return end if state == 8 then return end -- the fight handler owns this if state ~= 3 and state ~= 12 then arm_watch () return end -- not able to move yet: wait, do not count if pending.run then -- stopped part-way (a lag, an interruption): work out what is left from here pending = nil warn ("The run stopped short - carrying on from here.") schedule (PAUSE) return end pending.retries = pending.retries + 1 if pending.retries > 2 then abort ("The move @x048" .. pending.dir .. "@w did not take you anywhere.") return end warn ("No new room after @x048" .. pending.dir .. "@w - sending it again.") Execute (pending.dir) arm_watch () end
-- ---- reading the exits ------------------------------------ local function capture_exits () exits_buf, exits_for, exits_ready, exits_dark = {}, cur, false, false exits_wait = true ex_gen = ex_gen + 1 local om = debug_on and "n" or "y" SetTriggerOption ("PSXExitHeader", "omit_from_output", om) SetTriggerOption ("PSXExitLine", "omit_from_output", om) EnableTriggerGroup ("psx_exit", true) PSX_After (EXITS_TIMEOUT, "PSX_ExitsTimeout (" .. ex_gen .. ")") if debug_on then Send ("exits") else SendNoEcho ("exits") end end
function psx_exit_header (name, line, w) exits_buf = {} PSX_After (EXITS_SETTLE, "PSX_ExitsDone (" .. ex_gen .. ")") end
function psx_exit_line (name, line, w) local d = DIRKEY[(w[1] or ""):lower ()] if not d then return end local nm = (w[2] or ""):gsub ("^%s+", ""):gsub ("%s+$", "") if nm == "Too dark to see." then exits_dark = true end exits_buf[d] = nm end
local function pick_exit () local nxt = ROOMS[next_id (cur)] if not nxt then abort ("I have no data for the room after " .. tostring (cur) .. ".") return end local r = rooms[cur] if not r then r = { wrong = {} } rooms[cur] = r end local function candidates () local c = {} for _, d in ipairs (DIRS) do if exits_buf[d] == nxt.name and not r.wrong[d] then c[#c + 1] = d end end return c end local c = candidates () if #c == 0 and next (r.wrong) then -- everything that matched has been marked wrong: the maze must have -- changed under us. Forget the marks and look again. r.wrong = {} warn ("Every exit toward @x048" .. nxt.name .. "@w had been marked wrong - forgetting that.") c = candidates () end if #c == 0 then abort ("No exit here leads to @x048" .. nxt.name .. "@w.") return end if #c > 1 then dnote ("two exits match, trying " .. c[1] .. " first") end send_move (c[1]) end
function PSX_ExitsDone (g) if g ~= ex_gen then return end exits_wait = false EnableTriggerGroup ("psx_exit", false) if not walking then return end if exits_dark then abort ("You need @x048night vision@w to read the exits in this maze.") return end exits_ready = true if pending or exits_for ~= cur or state == 8 then return end pick_exit () end
function PSX_ExitsTimeout (g) if g ~= ex_gen or not exits_wait then return end exits_wait = false EnableTriggerGroup ("psx_exit", false) if walking then abort ("The exits list never came back.") end end
-- ---- deciding the next move ------------------------------- -- The known way from here: every room on from cur whose exit has been -- learned, up to the first room that has not (where the wrong exit was -- taken) or the target, whichever comes first. Never past the target. local function known_path () local dirs, ids, r = {}, {}, cur while r ~= target and #dirs < 60 do local rr = rooms[r] if APPROACH[r] or not (rr and rr.dir and rr.next and rr.ok) then break end dirs[#dirs + 1] = rr.dir ids[#ids + 1] = rr.next r = rr.next end return dirs, ids end
-- 2n e s w d -> "run 2nesw d"; "enter gate" cannot go in a run, so it -- is sent between runs, in order. local function run_command (dirs) local parts, i = {}, 1 while i <= #dirs do if #dirs[i] ~= 1 then parts[#parts + 1] = dirs[i] i = i + 1 else local seg = "" while i <= #dirs and #dirs[i] == 1 do local j = i while j < #dirs and dirs[j + 1] == dirs[i] do j = j + 1 end local n = j - i + 1 seg = seg .. (n > 1 and tostring (n) or "") .. dirs[i] i = j + 1 end parts[#parts + 1] = "run " .. seg end end return table.concat (parts, ";") end
local function send_run (dirs, ids) local cmd = run_command (dirs) pending = { from = cur, dir = cmd, run = true, ids = ids, idx = 1 } exits_ready = false dnote ("run from " .. tostring (cur) .. ": " .. cmd) Execute (cmd) arm_watch () end
local function decide_move () local ap = APPROACH[cur] if ap then send_move (ap, true) return end local r = rooms[cur] if r and r.dir then local dirs, ids = known_path () if fast_known and #dirs > 1 then send_run (dirs, ids) else send_move (r.dir) end return end if GATE[cur] then send_move ("enter gate") return end if exits_ready and exits_for == cur then pick_exit () else capture_exits () end end
-- =========================================================== -- Invis / sneak / hide: look first, cast only what is missing -- -- A gagged affects list says which of the three are up and for how long; -- anything with MIN_LEFT seconds or more on it is left alone. The rest is -- cast ONCE and never checked again - wraith form gives these without saff -- listing them, and the game's "You are already ..." is answer enough. -- Hide lags a second, so after it the walk waits invis_delay from the hide -- message ("You are already hiding." goes at once). If the list cannot be -- read at all, everything is cast, as before. -- =========================================================== local KEYOF = { invis = "invis", sneak = "sneak", hide = "hide" }
-- "You are already ..." replies (wraith form etc. can give these without saff -- listing them). Only used so an already-hiding reply ends the hide wait. local ALREADY = { ["invisible"] = "invis", ["moving silently"] = "sneak", ["hiding"] = "hide" }
local function to_secs (t) local a, b, c = t:match ("^(%d+):(%d+):(%d+)$") if a then return tonumber (a) * 3600 + tonumber (b) * 60 + tonumber (c) end a, b = t:match ("^(%d+):(%d+)$") if a then return tonumber (a) * 60 + tonumber (b) end return nil end
-- invis_cmds, each tied to the effect it makes (or to nothing); hide last. local function parse_cmds () local plan, hide = {}, nil for piece in invis_cmds:gmatch ("[^;]+") do local c = piece:gsub ("^%s+", ""):gsub ("%s+$", "") if c ~= "" then local low, key = c:lower (), nil if low:find ("invis", 1, true) then key = "invis" elseif low:match ("^sneak") then key = "sneak" elseif low:match ("^hide") then key = "hide" end local p = { cmd = c, key = key } if key == "hide" then hide = p else plan[#plan + 1] = p end end end if hide then plan[#plan + 1] = hide end return plan end
-- absent_only: the check after casting. A skill that is up cannot be cast -- again ("You are already moving silently."), so one with a little time left -- is not chased - only one that is not there at all is. local function missing (plan, list, known_only, absent_only) local miss = {} for _, p in ipairs (plan) do if p.key then local left = list[p.key] if absent_only then if not left then miss[#miss + 1] = p end elseif not (left and left >= MIN_LEFT) then miss[#miss + 1] = p end elseif not known_only then miss[#miss + 1] = p end end return miss end
local function names_of (list) local t = {} for _, p in ipairs (list) do t[#t + 1] = p.key or p.cmd end return table.concat (t, ", ") end
-- ---- the gagged affects list ------------------------------ local function aff_done (list) local cb = aff_cb aff_cb, aff_wait, aff_buf = nil, false, nil EnableTriggerGroup ("psx_aff", false) EnableTriggerGroup ("psx_aff_lines", false) if cb then cb (list) end end
local function aff_arm_settle () aff_set = aff_set + 1 PSX_After (AFF_SETTLE, "PSX_AffSettle (" .. aff_gen .. "," .. aff_set .. ")") end
local function query_affects (cb, timeout) aff_gen = aff_gen + 1 aff_set = 0 aff_cb, aff_wait, aff_buf = cb, true, nil local om = debug_on and "n" or "y" SetTriggerOption ("PSXAffHeader", "omit_from_output", om) SetTriggerOption ("PSXAffLine", "omit_from_output", om) SetTriggerOption ("PSXAffFooter", "omit_from_output", om) SetTriggerOption ("PSXAffBlank", "omit_from_output", om) EnableTriggerGroup ("psx_aff_lines", false) EnableTriggerGroup ("psx_aff", true) PSX_After (timeout, "PSX_AffTimeout (" .. aff_gen .. ")") if aff_cmd == "affects" or aff_cmd == "saff" then SendNoEcho (aff_cmd) else Execute (aff_cmd) end end
function psx_aff_header (name, line, w) if not aff_wait then return end aff_buf = {} EnableTriggerGroup ("psx_aff_lines", true) aff_arm_settle () end
function psx_aff_line (name, line, w) if not aff_wait or not aff_buf then return end local key = KEYOF[(w[2] or ""):lower ()] if key then local left = to_secs ((w[3] or ""):match ("([%d:]+)%s*$") or "") or 1e9 if not aff_buf[key] or left > aff_buf[key] then aff_buf[key] = left end end aff_arm_settle () end
-- "You are affected by 3 skills and 58 spells." closes the list. function psx_aff_footer (name, line, w) if not aff_wait then return end aff_done (aff_buf or {}) end
function PSX_AffSettle (g, n) if g ~= aff_gen or n ~= aff_set or not aff_wait then return end aff_done (aff_buf or {}) end
function PSX_AffTimeout (g) if g ~= aff_gen or not aff_wait then return end aff_done (nil) end
-- ---- the cast routine ------------------------------------- buff_cancel = function () buff = nil buff_gen = buff_gen + 1 aff_gen = aff_gen + 1 aff_cb, aff_wait, aff_buf = nil, false, nil EnableTriggerGroup ("psx_aff", false) EnableTriggerGroup ("psx_aff_lines", false) end
local function buff_finish_check () if not buff or not buff.verified or not buff.settled then return end buff = nil schedule (0.1) end
local function buff_start_hide_timer () if not buff or not buff.hide_cast or buff.timer then return end buff.timer = true PSX_After (invis_delay, "PSX_HideSettled (" .. buff.gen .. "," .. buff.tn .. ")") end
-- Send these; hide always last, and then it is the walk that has to wait. local function buff_cast (list) local hide = nil for _, p in ipairs (list) do if p.key == "hide" then hide = p else Execute (p.cmd) end end if hide then buff.hide_cast, buff.settled, buff.timer = true, false, false buff.tn = buff.tn + 1 Execute (hide.cmd) PSX_After (HIDE_FALLBACK, "PSX_HideFallback (" .. buff.gen .. "," .. buff.tn .. ")") end end
function psx_hide_done (name, line, w) buff_start_hide_timer () end
-- "You are already invisible / moving silently / hiding." - it is up, so -- nothing to wait for. An already-hiding reply has no lag: go at once. function psx_already (name, line, w) local key = ALREADY[w[1] or ""] if not key then return end dnote ("game says " .. key .. " is already up") if key == "hide" and buff and buff.hide_cast and not buff.timer then buff.timer, buff.settled = true, true buff_finish_check () end end
function PSX_HideSettled (g, n) if not buff or buff.gen ~= g or buff.tn ~= n then return end buff.settled = true buff_finish_check () end
-- The game never said it hid, and nothing has been able to tell us either. function PSX_HideFallback (g, n) if not buff or buff.gen ~= g or buff.tn ~= n or buff.settled or buff.timer then return end if buff.verified then warn ("No hide message after " .. HIDE_FALLBACK .. "s - carrying on anyway.") buff.settled = true buff_finish_check () end end
local function buff_start (why) buff_gen = buff_gen + 1 buff = { gen = buff_gen, tries = 0, tn = 0, plan = parse_cmds (), settled = true, verified = false, timer = false, hide_cast = false } local g, plan = buff.gen, buff.plan if not check_buffs then note (why .. ": @x048" .. invis_cmds .. "@w") buff_cast (plan) buff.verified = true buff_finish_check () return end query_affects (function (list) if not buff or buff.gen ~= g or not walking then return end if not list then warn ("No affects list came back from @x048" .. aff_cmd .. "@w - casting everything. " .. "(@x048psx affcmd <command>@w changes it)") buff_cast (plan) buff.verified = true buff_finish_check () return end local miss = missing (plan, list) if #miss == 0 then local up = {} for _, p in ipairs (plan) do if p.key then up[#up + 1] = p.key end end note (why .. ": @x048" .. table.concat (up, ", ") .. "@w already up - going.") buff.verified = true buff_finish_check () return end note (why .. ": casting @x048" .. names_of (miss) .. "@w.") buff_cast (miss) -- once: no recheck, no recast buff.verified = true buff_finish_check () -- goes now, or once hide has settled end, AFF_TIMEOUT) end
function PSX_Step (g) if g ~= step_gen or not walking then return end if state == 8 then return end -- fight end restarts this if buff then return end -- the cast routine restarts this when it is done if not in_area (cur) then abort ("You are not in the Partroxis any more.") return end if cur == target then arrive () return end if POS[cur] > POS[target] then abort ("@x048" .. roomlabel (target) .. "@w is behind you now, and the exits are one way.") return end if pending then schedule (0.5) return end -- the watchdog deals with a stuck move if need_invis then need_invis = false buff_start (invis_why) return end decide_move () end
-- ---- learning from where a move landed us ----------------- local function learn (p, num) local exp = next_id (p.from) local r = rooms[p.from] if not r then r = { wrong = {} } rooms[p.from] = r end if num == exp then r.dir, r.next, r.ok = p.dir, num, true dnote ("room " .. p.from .. ": " .. p.dir .. " is right") return end if r.dir == p.dir then -- a way that worked before has failed: the maze was reshuffled rooms, map_start = {}, os.time () warn ("The maze has changed since I learned it - forgetting the map and relearning.") else r.wrong[p.dir] = true end note ("Wrong way (@x048" .. p.dir .. "@w) out of @x048" .. roomlabel (p.from) .. "@w - doubling back.") end
-- =========================================================== -- GMCP (direct, option 201) -- =========================================================== local gWin = nil -- forward: the list window (defined below) function PSX_WinAreaCheck () end
local function on_room (num) local prev = cur cur = num -- a trip back in: assume the same maze, but trust none of the map -- until a step proves it (the first wrong one wipes it in learn) if not walking and in_area (num) and (not in_area (prev) or (num == 5862 and prev ~= 5862)) then local now = os.time () if not map_start or now - map_start >= MAP_LIFE then rooms, map_start = {}, now -- too old: a new maze, quietly exits_ready = false end local n = 0 for id, r in pairs (rooms) do if r.dir then r.ok = false n = n + 1 else rooms[id] = nil end end if n > 0 then note ("Using the @x048" .. n .. "@w exit" .. (n == 1 and "" or "s") .. " I learned last time - if one is wrong, the maze changed and I relearn.") end end PSX_WinAreaCheck (num) if num == 5763 and prev ~= 5763 and auto_list and not walking then PSX_After (0.5, "PSX_Menu ()") end if not walking then return end if not in_area (num) then abort ("You have left the Partroxis.") return end if pending then local p = pending if num == p.from then return end -- no move yet (a look, say) if p.run then if num == p.ids[p.idx] then p.idx = p.idx + 1 if p.idx <= #p.ids then p.from = num -- still on the way arm_watch () return end pending = nil -- the run is finished else pending, rooms, map_start = nil, {}, os.time () warn ("The run did not land where the map said - forgetting the map.") end else pending = nil if not p.approach then learn (p, num) end end end -- A room whose way on is already known (doubling back to where a wrong -- exit was taken) needs no pause: the next move is certain and one step -- is still sent per arrival, with the target checked first, so it still -- cannot run past the room you picked. Rooms it has to work out keep -- the full pause. local r = rooms[num] if fast_known and r and r.dir and num ~= target and state ~= 8 and not APPROACH[num] then step_gen = step_gen + 1 PSX_Step (step_gen) return end schedule (PAUSE) end
-- A fight stops the walk outright. Nothing carries on by itself: once -- the fight is over the player types psxgo, and that walk casts first. local function on_status (s) local prev = state state = s if s == 8 and prev ~= 8 and walking then stop_walk () -- drops the queued step, the move, any cast in flight fight_stop = true note ("Under attack - walk stopped. Type @x048psxgo@w once the fight is over.") elseif prev == 8 and s ~= 8 and fight_stop then note ("Fight over - type @x048psxgo@w to carry on to @x048" .. roomlabel (target) .. "@w.") end end
function OnPluginTelnetSubnegotiation (t, data) if t ~= 201 or type (data) ~= "string" then return end local pkg, body = data:match ("^([%w%._]+)%s+(.*)$") if pkg == "room.info" then local num = tonumber (body:match ('"num"%s*:%s*(-?%d+)')) if num then on_room (num) end elseif pkg == "char.status" then local s = tonumber (body:match ('"state"%s*:%s*(%d+)')) if s then on_status (s) end end end
-- =========================================================== -- Starting a walk -- =========================================================== function PSX_Go (id, nocast) id = tonumber (id) local r = id and ROOMS[id] if not r then warn ("That is not a room in the list.") return end if not cur then warn ("I do not know where you are yet - type @x048look@w and try again.") return end if not in_area (cur) then warn ("You are not at the Partroxis. Get to the Otherworld door first.") return end if cur == id then note ("You are already in @x048" .. r.name .. "@w with @x045" .. r.mob .. "@w.") return end if POS[cur] > POS[id] then warn ("@x048" .. r.name .. "@w (" .. r.mob .. ") is behind you - the exits are one way.") return end if state == 8 then stop_walk () target, fight_stop = id, true warn ("You are in a fight - type @x048psxgo@w once it is over and I will walk you to @x048" .. r.name .. "@w.") return end stop_walk () target, walking = id, true need_invis, invis_why = false, "" if fight_stop then need_invis, invis_why = true, "Fight over" elseif precast and not nocast then need_invis, invis_why = true, "Before the walk" end fight_stop = false note ("Walking to @x048" .. r.name .. "@w - @x045" .. r.mob .. "@w.") schedule (need_invis and 0.1 or PAUSE) -- the first step is just the affects check: no pause needed end
-- psxgo (and psx resume): carry on to the room picked last. function psx_go_command () if not target then warn ("There is nothing to carry on with - type @x048psx@w and pick a room.") return end if walking then note ("Already walking to @x048" .. roomlabel (target) .. "@w.") return end if state == 8 then warn ("Still fighting - type @x048psxgo@w once the fight is over.") return end PSX_Go (target, true) end
function psx_area_reset () rooms, map_start = {}, os.time () exits_ready = false if walking then -- Drop whatever was in flight (it was aimed at the old maze) and carry -- on toward the same room from wherever we are now. A room.info that -- arrives after this restarts the step from the new room. If the -- reset left the target behind us, or put us outside the Partroxis, -- the next step says so and stops. wd_gen = wd_gen + 1 ex_gen = ex_gen + 1 exits_wait = false pending = nil EnableTriggerGroup ("psx_exit", false) note ("The Partroxis reset - map forgotten, carrying on from here.") schedule (1.0) else note ("The Partroxis reset - map forgotten.") end end
-- =========================================================== -- The list window (psx) -- Built the way MazeMobber builds its pop-up: a TextRect link whose text is -- not a URL runs as Lua; a click hides the window at once and destroys it -- on a timer, after the callback; a window the library no longer knows -- about is a zombie and never reused; Repaint after showing. -- =========================================================== local WIN_ID = "Partroxis_list" local win_max_h = tonumber (GetVariable ("winheight") or "") or 560 -- pixels; a longer list scrolls local win_gen = 0 local win_closing = false -- hidden by a click, not destroyed yet: a room change must not put it back
local function win_line (segs) local styles, links, pos = {}, {}, 1 for _, sg in ipairs (segs) do if sg.text ~= "" then styles[#styles + 1] = { text = sg.text, textcolour = ColourNameToRGB (sg.colour or CLR_MSG) } if sg.code then links[#links + 1] = { start = pos, stop = pos + #sg.text - 1, text = sg.code, label = sg.tip } end pos = pos + #sg.text end end return styles, links end
function PSX_WinDestroy (tok) if tok and tok ~= win_gen then return end win_closing = false local w = gWin gWin = nil if w then pcall (function () w:delete (true) end) end pcall (WindowDelete, WIN_ID) pcall (Repaint) end
local function win_close () win_closing = true win_gen = win_gen + 1 pcall (WindowShow, WIN_ID, false) pcall (Repaint) PSX_After (0.2, "PSX_WinDestroy (" .. win_gen .. ")") end
function PSX_WinPick (id) if debug_on then dnote ("window click -> " .. tostring (id)) end win_close () PSX_Go (id) end
-- The rows, once, for both the window and the chat list. local function list_rows () local rows = {} for i, r in ipairs (ROWS) do local id = r[1] rows[#rows + 1] = { n = i, id = id, label = r[2], mob = r[3], here = (cur == id), behind = (cur ~= nil and POS[cur] ~= nil and POS[cur] > POS[id]), } end return rows end
-- Line (1 is the heading) of the first room that is not behind you. The -- window follows its newest line like a console, so left alone it opens -- scrolled to the BOTTOM and the rooms you are about to click - the first -- ones - sit above the visible area, with the cut-off landing wherever the -- window height and your font happen to put it. local function first_ahead_line () local p = cur and POS[cur] if not p or p <= 1 then return 1 end return p + 1 end
-- keep_scroll: a redraw of a list that is already up (you moved) must not -- throw away where you had scrolled it to. local function win_open (keep_scroll) if type (ThemedTextWindow) ~= "function" then return false end win_closing = false win_gen = win_gen + 1 if gWin and not (ThemedWindowClass and ThemedWindowClass.window_map and ThemedWindowClass.window_map[WIN_ID]) then gWin = nil pcall (WindowDelete, WIN_ID) end if not gWin then local ok, w = pcall (ThemedTextWindow, WIN_ID, 386, 0, -- default left, top 560, 300, -- default width, height (fit_contents resizes it) "Partroxis", -- title "center", true, -- title-bar close button false, -- resizeable true, -- text scrolls (mouse wheel and a scrollbar) false, false, false, true, -- autowrap win_font, win_font_size, win_font, win_font_size, 300, -- max lines nil, true, -- defer showing until drawn false, nil, "Close") if not ok or not w then return false end gWin = w if gWin.textrect and gWin.textrect.font_bold then gWin.textrect.font = gWin.textrect.font_bold end local prior = gWin.do_on_delete gWin.do_on_delete = function (self) if prior then prior (self) end gWin = nil end -- right-click "Bring To Front" would only reach the top z-order slot, -- still under the layout's drag bar (1.5, see the end of win_open) gWin.bring_to_front = function (self) pcall (WindowSetZOrder, WIN_ID, 99999) end end
local keep = nil if keep_scroll and gWin.textrect then keep = tonumber (gWin.textrect.display_start_line) end gWin:clear (false) local st, lk = win_line { { text = "Partroxis - click a room to walk there:", colour = CLR_NAME } } gWin:add_text (st, false, lk) for _, r in ipairs (list_rows ()) do local code = string.format ("PSX_WinPick(%d)", r.id) local tip = r.behind and "Behind you - the exits are one way" or ("Walk to " .. r.label) local namec = r.behind and CLR_TAG or CLR_MSG local mobc = r.behind and CLR_TAG or CLR_NAME local segs = { { text = " " }, { text = string.format ("%2d", r.n), colour = CLR_HI, code = code, tip = tip }, { text = " " }, { text = r.label, colour = namec, code = code, tip = tip }, { text = string.rep (" ", math.max (1, 30 - #r.label)) }, { text = r.mob, colour = mobc, code = code, tip = tip }, } if r.here then segs[#segs + 1] = { text = " <- you are here", colour = CLR_HI } end st, lk = win_line (segs) gWin:add_text (st, false, lk) end pcall (function () gWin:fit_contents (1000, win_max_h) end) pcall (function () gWin:set_scroll (keep or first_ahead_line ()) end) gWin:draw () gWin:show () -- ABOVE EVERY OTHER MINIWINDOW (1.5). The package layout plugin -- (aard_layout.xml, add_title_dragger) lays an INVISIBLE 15px drag bar -- along the top edge of the main text area - transparent, so nothing -- shows, but it takes the mouse - at z-order 154 on a typical screen. This -- window got slot 19 from the z-order monitor, so whichever row lay -- across that bar could not be clicked. Found in MazeMobber (7.8) with -- its mm wincheck; raising the window fixed the row there. 99999 is what -- the package mapper uses for its config window. win_open runs on every -- room move while the list is up, which re-applies this after the z-order -- monitor re-stacks everything (it does whenever ANY window is boosted). pcall (WindowSetZOrder, WIN_ID, 99999) pcall (Repaint) return true end
-- Walked out of the area: put the list away. Redraw it as you move. function PSX_WinAreaCheck (num) if not gWin or win_closing then return end if not in_area (num) then win_close () return end win_open (true) end
local function menu_chat () note_now ("Partroxis - click a room to walk there:") for _, r in ipairs (list_rows ()) do local cmd = "psx " .. r.n ColourTell (CLR_TAG, "", " ") Hyperlink (cmd, string.format ("%2d", r.n), "Walk to " .. r.label, CLR_HI, "black", 0, 1) ColourTell (CLR_TAG, "", " ") Hyperlink (cmd, r.label, "Walk to " .. r.label, r.behind and CLR_TAG or CLR_MSG, "black", 0, 1) ColourTell (CLR_TAG, "", string.rep (" ", math.max (1, 30 - #r.label))) ColourNote (r.behind and CLR_TAG or CLR_NAME, "", r.mob .. (r.here and " <- you are here" or "")) end end
function PSX_Menu () if not win_open () then menu_chat () end end
local function win_refont () if not gWin then return end win_gen = win_gen + 1 PSX_WinDestroy () win_open () end
-- =========================================================== -- Commands -- =========================================================== local function show_help () local lines = { "@x048psx@w the room list - click a room and it walks you there", "@x048psx <n>@w walk to row n of the list", "@x048psx stop@w stop walking", "@x048psxgo@w carry on after a stop, or after a fight (it never carries on by itself)", "", "It walks one exit at a time and pauses @x0480.3s@w in every room it has to work out,", "so it stops in the room you picked - the exits are one way, no second chance.", "Doubling back to a wrong exit goes as one @x048run@w command - no pauses.", "Before it starts it reads your affects and casts only the invis / sneak / hide that are missing.", "A wrong exit is remembered and doubled back from. If you are attacked the walk stops;", "once the fight is over type @x048psxgo@w and it checks the three again and carries on.", "", "@x048psx auto@w the list pops up when you reach the maze door (toggle)", "@x048psx fast@w walk a known stretch (doubling back) as one run, no pauses (toggle)", "@x048psx precast@w cast the invis commands before every new walk (toggle; now " .. (precast and "on" or "off") .. ")", "@x048psx check@w read your affects first and cast only what is missing (toggle; now " .. (check_buffs and "on" or "off") .. ")", "@x048psx affcmd <cmd>@w the command that lists your affects (now: @x048" .. aff_cmd .. "@w)", "@x048psx invisdelay <s>@w wait after the hide message, before moving (now: @x048" .. invis_delay .. "s@w)", "@x048psx invis <cmds>@w what to send after a fight (now: @x048" .. invis_cmds .. "@w)", "@x048psx reset@w forget the learned directions (they are kept when you leave the area;", " the first wrong one on the way back in clears them by itself)", "@x048psx font@w pick the list window's font (or @x048psx font <name>@w)", "@x048psx fontsize <n>@w the list window's font size", "@x048psx winheight <px>@w how tall the list window may get (now @x048" .. win_max_h .. "@w) - taller shows more rooms without scrolling", "@x048psx debug@w show what it is doing", "@x048psx reload@w load this plugin again after an update", "", "The right exit is found by matching the exit names to the next room's name.", "When two exits match, it tries one and learns from where it lands.", } note_now ("Partroxis @x048v" .. VERSION .. "@w") for _, l in ipairs (lines) do cnote (" @w" .. l) end end
function psx_command (name, line, w) local arg = (w[1] or ""):gsub ("^%s+", ""):gsub ("%s+$", "") local low = arg:lower ()
if low == "" or low == "list" or low == "win" or low == "window" then PSX_Menu () return end
if low == "help" then show_help () return end
if low == "version" then note ("Partroxis @x048v" .. VERSION .. "@w.") return end
if low == "stop" then if walking then stop_walk () note ("Stopped.") else note ("Not walking.") end return end
if low == "resume" or low == "r" or low == "go" then psx_go_command () return end
if low == "reset" then rooms = {} note ("Learned directions forgotten.") return end
if low == "auto" then auto_list = not auto_list SetVariable ("auto", auto_list and "y" or "n") note ("List on arrival: @x048" .. (auto_list and "on" or "off") .. "@w.") return end
if low == "check" then check_buffs = not check_buffs SetVariable ("check", check_buffs and "y" or "n") note ("Read your affects first and cast only what is missing: @x048" .. (check_buffs and "on" or "off") .. "@w.") return end
local ac = arg:match ("^[Aa][Ff][Ff][Cc][Mm][Dd]%s*(.*)$") if ac then if ac == "" then note ("The command that lists your affects is @x048" .. aff_cmd .. "@w (change it: @x048psx affcmd <command>@w).") else aff_cmd = ac SetVariable ("affcmd", aff_cmd) note ("Affects are read with @x048" .. aff_cmd .. "@w.") end return end
if low == "precast" then precast = not precast SetVariable ("precast", precast and "y" or "n") note ("Cast invis / hide / sneak before every walk: @x048" .. (precast and "on" or "off") .. "@w.") return end
if low == "fast" then fast_known = not fast_known SetVariable ("fast", fast_known and "y" or "n") note ("Known stretches go as one run: @x048" .. (fast_known and "on" or "off") .. "@w.") return end
if low == "debug" then debug_on = not debug_on note ("Debug @x048" .. (debug_on and "on" or "off") .. "@w.") return end
if low == "reload" then stop_walk () note ("Reloading Partroxis from disk (this was @x048v" .. VERSION .. "@w)...") Execute (GetAlphaOption ("script_prefix") .. 'DoAfterSpecial(1, "ReloadPlugin(\'' .. GetPluginID () .. '\')", sendto.script)') return end
local idl = arg:match ("^[Ii][Nn][Vv][Ii][Ss][Dd][Ee][Ll][Aa][Yy]%s*(.*)$") if idl then local n = tonumber (idl) if not n or n < 0.3 or n > 6 then warn ("Give seconds from 0.3 to 6 - @x048psx invisdelay 1.5@w (the wait after hide). It is " .. invis_delay .. " now.") return end invis_delay = n SetVariable ("invisdelay", tostring (n)) note ("Wait after hide: @x048" .. n .. "s@w.") return end
local ic = arg:match ("^[Ii][Nn][Vv][Ii][Ss]%s+(.+)$") if ic then invis_cmds = ic SetVariable ("invis", invis_cmds) note ("After a fight I will send: @x048" .. invis_cmds .. "@w") return end if low == "invis" then note ("After a fight I send: @x048" .. invis_cmds .. "@w (change it: @x048psx invis <cmds>@w)") return end
local wh = arg:match ("^[Ww][Ii][Nn][Hh][Ee][Ii][Gg][Hh][Tt]%s*(.*)$") if wh then local n = tonumber (wh) if not n or n < 200 or n > 1600 then warn ("Give a height in pixels from 200 to 1600 - @x048psx winheight 800@w. It is " .. win_max_h .. " now. The whole list needs about @x048" .. (#ROWS + 1) * 20 .. "@w at the default font.") return end win_max_h = math.floor (n) SetVariable ("winheight", tostring (win_max_h)) note ("List window height: @x048" .. win_max_h .. "@w pixels.") win_refont () return end
local fs = arg:match ("^[Ff][Oo][Nn][Tt][Ss][Ii][Zz][Ee]%s*(.*)$") if fs then local n = tonumber (fs) if not n or n < 6 or n > 40 then warn ("Give a size from 6 to 40 - @x048psx fontsize 12@w. It is " .. win_font_size .. " now.") return end win_font_size = math.floor (n) SetVariable ("winfontsize", tostring (win_font_size)) note ("List window font: @x048" .. win_font .. " " .. win_font_size .. "@w.") win_refont () return end
local fn = arg:match ("^[Ff][Oo][Nn][Tt]%s*(.*)$") if fn then if fn == "" then local ok, f = pcall (utils.fontpicker, win_font, win_font_size, 0) if not ok or not f then return end win_font = f.name or win_font win_font_size = tonumber (f.size) or win_font_size SetVariable ("winfontsize", tostring (win_font_size)) else win_font = fn end SetVariable ("winfont", win_font) note ("List window font: @x048" .. win_font .. " " .. win_font_size .. "@w.") win_refont () return end
local n = tonumber (arg:match ("^go%s+(%d+)$") or arg) if n and ROWS[n] then PSX_Go (ROWS[n][1]) return end
warn ("I do not know @x048" .. arg .. "@w. Type @x048psx help@w.") end
-- =========================================================== -- Install / teardown -- =========================================================== function OnPluginInstall () pcall (WindowDelete, WIN_ID) -- one left over from last session -- where we are, if the GMCP handler already has data (asking it before any -- GMCP has arrived makes it print "No gmcpdata variable set") local gd = GetPluginVariable (GMCP_ID, "gmcpdata") if gd and gd ~= "" then local ok, _, val = pcall (CallPlugin, GMCP_ID, "gmcpval", "room.info") if ok and type (val) == "string" then local n = tonumber (val:match ("num%W+(-?%d+)")) if n then cur = n end end ok, _, val = pcall (CallPlugin, GMCP_ID, "gmcpval", "char.status") if ok and type (val) == "string" then local s = tonumber (val:match ("state%W+(%d+)")) if s then state = s end end end note ("@x048v" .. VERSION .. "@w loaded - Type @x048psx@w in the Partroxis. See @x048psx help@w.") end
function OnPluginClose () pcall (WindowDelete, WIN_ID) end
function OnPluginDisable () stop_walk () end
function OnPluginSaveState () SetVariable ("invis", invis_cmds) SetVariable ("auto", auto_list and "y" or "n") SetVariable ("fast", fast_known and "y" or "n") SetVariable ("invisdelay", tostring (invis_delay)) SetVariable ("precast", precast and "y" or "n") SetVariable ("check", check_buffs and "y" or "n") SetVariable ("affcmd", aff_cmd) SetVariable ("winfont", win_font) SetVariable ("winfontsize", tostring (win_font_size)) SetVariable ("winheight", tostring (win_max_h)) end
function OnHelp () world.Note (world.GetPluginInfo (world.GetPluginID (), 3)) end
